title: Stack Overflow Scraper
description: Search public Stack Overflow and Stack Exchange questions or fetch exact question and user IDs through the official Stack Exchange API.

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Keywords or phrases for advanced question search, such as "async await" or "memory leak".

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Up to five tags. With search queries they filter search; without a query they list questions matching all tags.

questionIds.title: Question IDs
questionIds.description: Exact positive Stack Exchange question IDs to fetch, processed after searches and subject to Max Questions.

userIds.title: User IDs
userIds.description: Exact positive public user IDs to fetch. User rows are separate from the Max Questions cap.

sort.title: Sort By
sort.description: Votes, activity, and creation work broadly. Hot is tag-only; relevance is keyword-search-only and cannot be combined with exact question IDs.

includeBody.title: Include Question Body
includeBody.description: Include the question body converted from API HTML to plain text.

maxResults.title: Max Questions
maxResults.description: Maximum unique question rows across searches, tags, and exact IDs. Use 1-5 for a quick test.

site.title: Stack Exchange Site
site.description: Official API site parameter, such as stackoverflow, superuser, serverfault, askubuntu, or math.

apiKey.title: Stack Apps API Key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional Stack Apps key for a higher daily request quota. The no-key quota is normally 300 requests per source IP per day.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually keep disabled for the official API. Use an API key, rather than proxy rotation, when a higher quota is needed.
